_question: R5-Q4: per-arm sample size needed to declare TG strictly above the post-freeze baselines at alpha=0.05, 80% power, two-sided Fisher exact, given the round-4 effect sizes.
interpretation: Under the round-4 observed proportions (TG 5/15 vs FTM 2/15 vs Pytea 3/15), a two-sided Fisher exact test reaches 80% power at approximately N >= 80 per arm against FakeTensorMode and N >= 187 per arm against Pytea.  The shipped N=15 sample is therefore directionally informative but underpowered against either baseline at the observed effect size.  This is a corpus-collection cost question, not a tool-quality question: catching unbiased post-freeze PRs is the throughput bottleneck.  An N >= 187 replication on a future-collected post-freeze sample would be sufficient to upgrade the directional result to a statistically separable comparison.
